pattern.description: Behind a dimmed 'Loading...' overlay the previous report view is replaced by the full income statement / balance sheet table; headers and value columns populate within a few frames.
pattern.why_premium: Keeping the loading modal and dim overlay in shot sells the real-time data pull while the table resolving underneath shows the payoff without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Overlay stays at opacity 0.75; gsap.fromTo('.report-table', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.out'}) with header band first, then value columns stagger: 0.02 left to right.
build_hint.remotion: interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [0, 1]) on table opacity under a fixed dark overlay; columns offset by 1 frame each; no spring needed (near-step change).

notes: Very short burst (about 0.2 s) of a raw screen-recorded page load under a dark overlay; numbers are too dim to transcribe, so value cells are marked non-text. Many diff boxes are individual table cells; only representative ones listed. Could also be read as a plain page swap rather than a designed skeleton resolve.
